title: Patient Financial Account — Schedule A, Financial Classes and Entry Criteria
content:
Every Patient Financial Account at Linden Ridge Medical Group is carried on one of seven financial classes. The class is the tier of the account, and a coverage belongs to a class only when it meets every entry criterion listed for that class.

## Entry criteria by financial class

| Financial class (tier) | Coverage presented | Further criteria, all required |
|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | Medicaid managed care plan | eligibility verified with the payer; plan contracted with the group |
| Self-Pay Account | no coverage | uninsured attestation signed |
| Medicare Part B Account | Medicare Part B | eligibility verified with the payer; the group is participating |
| Medicare Advantage Account | Medicare Advantage plan | eligibility verified with the payer; plan contracted with the group |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | commercial HMO or EPO plan | eligibility verified with the payer; plan contracted with the group; primary care physician assigned within the group |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | commercial PPO or POS plan | eligibility verified with the payer; plan contracted with the group |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | commercial high-deductible health plan | eligibility verified with the payer; plan contracted with the group; enrolled with a payment card on file |

## Coverage re-verification period

The re-verification period is the number of calendar days after the last eligibility verification recorded on the account beyond which coverage is re-verified before the next posting to the payer.

| Financial class (tier) | Re-verification period (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 30 |
| Self-Pay Account | 90 |
| Medicare Part B Account | 365 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 90 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 90 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 90 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 90 |

## Reading the schedule

- **A plan that is contracted but whose eligibility has not been verified** meets none of the insured classes above, because verification is a criterion of every insured class.
- **A commercial HMO or EPO plan with no primary care physician assigned within the group** does not meet the Commercial HMO/EPO Account criteria; the three HMO/EPO criteria are cumulative.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** An account last verified on day 0 on the Medicare Part B Account is still inside its re-verification period on day 365 and is past it from day 366; on the Medicaid Managed Care Account the same account would be past it from day 31.
